summary: Short 12 m kerb on busy Moggill Road, bus zone, houses beside.
reasons: Bus zone sign; shorter than a van's usable room
Dwelling 9 m from end of kerb

drivers.seclusion: Shops and detached houses 7-9 m from the kerb, multi-lane road in front.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 12 m of kerb beside a junction and zebra-hatched island; no pull-in.
drivers.convention: Bus zone (Mon-Sat 4-7pm); no cars parked along this kerb.

sun_shade: Large tree shades the kerb from the south and west.
